listen_addresses.description: IP addresses and ports to listen on for DNS queries (used as --addr=... in DAEMON_ARGS)

config_file_path.description: Path to the main kresd configuration file (used as --config=... in DAEMON_ARGS)

daemon_extra_args.description: Additional arguments appended to DAEMON_ARGS (e.g., --verbose, --daemonize). Do not set --config= or --addr= here.
